de.brand_intro: ABCspareparts beschafft 3M Produkte für Instandhaltung und Produktion – Schleifmittel, Klebebänder und Klebstoffe, Elektroisolierung und persönliche Schutzausrüstung – für Industriekunden in ganz Europa. de.brand_intro_p2: Wir prüfen die Verfügbarkeit des Originalprodukts und bei Auslaufartikeln, wo technisch sinnvoll, gleichwertige Alternativen. Diese Seite ersetzt keine Live-Bestandsliste: Nutzen Sie bitte die unverbindliche Anfrage.
de.bx_about_text:
3M wurde 1902 als Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Company gegründet, begann mit der Herstellung von Schleifpapier und hat seinen Hauptsitz in St. Paul, Minnesota (USA). Das Unternehmen ist an der New Yorker Börse notiert (NYSE: MMM).

3M ist heute in drei Geschäftssegmente gegliedert: Safety and Industrial (u. a. Arbeitsschutz, Klebebänder und Klebstoffe, Schleifmittel, Elektrotechnik), Transportation and Electronics und Consumer. Das Medizingeschäft wurde am 1. April 2024 als eigenständiges Unternehmen Solventum abgespalten.
de.bx_products_intro: Für Instandhaltung und Produktion betreffen typische Anfragen folgende Bereiche:
de.bx_products_list:
• Schleifmittel – z. B. 3M Cubitron II Fiberscheiben und Schleifbänder, Scotch-Brite Vliesprodukte zur Oberflächenbearbeitung, Roloc Schnellwechselscheiben
  • Klebebänder und Klebstoffe – z. B. 3M VHB Hochleistungs-Klebebänder, Scotch-Weld Strukturklebstoffe, Transferklebebänder und Abdeckbänder
  • Elektroisolierung und Kabelzubehör – z. B. Scotch Super 33+ Vinyl-Isolierband, Scotch 23 selbstverschweißendes Band, Kaltschrumpf-Garnituren, Scotchcast Gießharze
  • Atemschutz – Halb- und Vollmasken der Serien 6000 und 7500, Filter, Aura Atemschutzmasken, Versaflo Gebläsefiltergeräte
  • Schweißerschutz – 3M Speedglas Schweißmasken, Automatikfilter und Ersatzsichtscheiben
  • Augen-, Gehör- und Kopfschutz – Schutzbrillen (z. B. SecureFit), E-A-R Gehörschutzstöpsel; Kapselgehörschutz und Headsets siehe 3M PELTOR
  • Absturzsicherung – 3M DBI-SALA Auffanggurte, Höhensicherungsgeräte und Verbindungsmittel
de.bx_tech_title: Worauf es bei 3M Anfragen ankommt
de.bx_tech_list:
• 3M ID bzw. Produktnummer: 3M führt neben dem Produktnamen eine Produktnummer und eine 3M ID (früher „3M Stock“) – mit dieser Nummer lässt sich die exakte Ausführung eindeutig bestimmen.
  • Abmessungen und Ausführung: bei Schleifmitteln Korn, Durchmesser und Befestigung; bei Klebebändern Breite, Länge, Dicke und Klebstoffsystem.
  • Normen bei PSA: z. B. EN 140/EN 14387 für Masken und Filter, EN 149 für partikelfiltrierende Masken, EN 175/EN 379 für Schweißerschutz – der Ersatz muss dieselbe Zulassung haben.
  • Haltbarkeit und Charge: Klebstoffe, Harze und Filter haben ein Verfallsdatum; wir achten auf ausreichende Restlaufzeit.
  • Auslaufprodukte: 3M hat die PFAS-Herstellung Ende 2025 eingestellt; Produkte wie Novec und Fluorinert Flüssigkeiten sind nicht mehr erhältlich – hier suchen wir Alternativen.
de.bx_apps_list:
• Instandhaltung und Werkstatt
  • Metallbearbeitung und Schweißen
  • Montage und Konstruktionskleben
  • Elektroinstallation und Kabelreparatur
  • Chemie, Pharma und Lebensmittel (Arbeitsschutz)
  • Fahrzeug-, Schienen- und Maschinenbau
  • Bau und Energieversorgung
de.bx_request_list:

  • Abmessungen, Körnung oder Größe
  • Bei PSA: Norm, Filterklasse oder Größe
  • Menge und Verpackungseinheit
  • Gewünschter Liefertermin
  • Nur Original oder gleichwertige Alternative möglich
de.brand_faq_q4: Beschafft ABCspareparts auch 3M Produkte, die nicht mehr hergestellt werden?
de.brand_faq_a4: Wir fragen bei Distributoren und Brokern in Europa nach Restbeständen. Für Produkte, die 3M im Zuge des PFAS-Ausstiegs eingestellt hat (z. B. Novec Flüssigkeiten), schlagen wir nach Rücksprache Alternativen anderer Hersteller vor.
de.brand_faq_q5: Welche Nummer brauche ich für eine 3M Anfrage?
de.brand_faq_a5: Am besten die 3M ID oder die Produktnummer vom Etikett oder aus der Rechnung, zusammen mit Produktname und Abmessungen. Damit ist die Ausführung eindeutig.
de.brand_faq_a6: Das frühere 3M Health Care Geschäft gehört seit April 2024 zu Solventum. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf Industrie- und MRO-Produkten von 3M; Anfragen zu anderen Bereichen prüfen wir im Einzelfall.
de.bx_note: 3M, Cubitron, Scotch-Brite, Roloc, VHB, Scotch, Scotch-Weld, Scotchcast, Aura, Versaflo, Speedglas, SecureFit, E-A-R, PELTOR und DBI-SALA sind Marken der 3M Company. Die Nennung dient ausschließlich der Identifikation der Produkte. Angaben basieren auf öffentlich zugänglichen Herstellerinformationen. Stand: September 2026.

en.meta_description: 3M for maintenance: Cubitron & Scotch-Brite abrasives, VHB tapes, Scotch electrical tapes, respirators, Speedglas. Send the 3M ID – quote often in 24 h.
en.brand_h1: 3M – abrasives, tapes, electrical insulation and safety products for industry
en.brand_intro: ABCspareparts sources 3M products for maintenance and production – abrasives, tapes and adhesives, electrical insulation and personal protective equipment – for industrial customers across Europe. Send us the product name or 3M ID and quantity – we usually reply within 24 hours.
en.brand_intro_p2: We check availability of the original product and, for discontinued items and where technically appropriate, equivalent alternatives. This page is not a live stock list: please use the non-binding request.
en.bx_about_text:
3M was founded in 1902 as the Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Company, started out making sandpaper and is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota (USA). The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: MMM).

Today 3M is organised in three business segments: Safety and Industrial (including personal safety, tapes and adhesives, abrasives, electrical), Transportation and Electronics and Consumer. The health care business was spun off as the independent company Solventum on 1 April 2024.
en.bx_products_intro: For maintenance and production, typical requests cover the following areas:
en.bx_products_list:
• Abrasives – e.g. 3M Cubitron II fibre discs and belts, Scotch-Brite non-woven surface conditioning products, Roloc quick-change discs
  • Tapes and adhesives – e.g. 3M VHB high-performance tapes, Scotch-Weld structural adhesives, transfer tapes and masking tapes
  • Electrical insulation and cable accessories – e.g. Scotch Super 33+ vinyl tape, Scotch 23 self-fusing rubber tape, cold shrink kits, Scotchcast resins
  • Respiratory protection – 6000 and 7500 series half and full masks, filters, Aura respirators, Versaflo powered air systems
  • Welding protection – 3M Speedglas welding helmets, auto-darkening filters and replacement lenses
  • Eye, hearing and head protection – safety glasses (e.g. SecureFit), E-A-R earplugs; earmuffs and headsets see 3M PELTOR
  • Fall protection – 3M DBI-SALA harnesses, self-retracting lifelines and lanyards
en.bx_tech_title: What matters in a 3M request
en.bx_tech_list:
• 3M ID or product number: besides the product name, 3M uses a product number and a 3M ID (formerly “3M Stock”) – this number identifies the exact version.
  • Dimensions and version: for abrasives grit, diameter and attachment; for tapes width, length, thickness and adhesive system.
  • PPE standards: e.g. EN 140/EN 14387 for masks and filters, EN 149 for filtering facepieces, EN 175/EN 379 for welding protection – the replacement must carry the same approval.
  • Shelf life and batch: adhesives, resins and filters have an expiry date; we make sure enough shelf life remains.
  • Discontinued products: 3M exited PFAS manufacturing at the end of 2025; products such as Novec and Fluorinert fluids are no longer available – we look for alternatives.
en.bx_apps_list:
• Maintenance and workshops
  • Metalworking and welding
  • Assembly and structural bonding
  • Electrical installation and cable repair
  • Chemicals, pharma and food (occupational safety)
  • Vehicle, rail and machine building
  • Construction and utilities
en.bx_request_title: This information speeds up your quote
en.bx_request_list:
• Product name and 3M ID or product number (a photo of the label helps)
  • Dimensions, grit or size
  • For PPE: standard, filter class or size
  • Quantity and pack size
  • Required delivery date
  • Original only, or equivalent alternative acceptable
en.brand_faq_q4: Does ABCspareparts also source 3M products that are no longer manufactured?
en.brand_faq_a4: We check with distributors and brokers in Europe for remaining stock. For products 3M discontinued as part of its PFAS exit (e.g. Novec fluids), we propose alternatives from other manufacturers after consultation.
en.brand_faq_q5: Which number do I need for a 3M request?
en.brand_faq_a5: Ideally the 3M ID or product number from the label or invoice, together with the product name and dimensions. This identifies the exact version.
en.brand_faq_q6: Does ABCspareparts also supply 3M medical products?
en.brand_faq_a6: The former 3M Health Care business has been part of Solventum since April 2024. Our focus is on 3M industrial and MRO products; we review requests for other areas case by case.
en.bx_note: 3M, Cubitron, Scotch-Brite, Roloc, VHB, Scotch, Scotch-Weld, Scotchcast, Aura, Versaflo, Speedglas, SecureFit, E-A-R, PELTOR and DBI-SALA are trademarks of 3M Company. Names are mentioned solely to identify products. Information is based on publicly available manufacturer information. Last updated: September 2026.

Oggi 3M è organizzata in tre segmenti: Safety and Industrial (tra cui sicurezza sul lavoro, nastri e adesivi, abrasivi, settore elettrico), Transportation and Electronics e Consumer. Il settore sanitario è stato scorporato il 1° aprile 2024 nella società indipendente Solventum.

PELTOR began in Sweden in 1950: founder Tore Palmaer developed hearing protection for the Swedish Air Force that also allowed communication in noise. Production was located in Värnamo. Through the acquisition of Aearo Technologies, PELTOR has been part of 3M since 2008.

Today 3M PELTOR is 3M's brand for earmuffs and communication headsets for loud and hazardous environments – from simple earmuffs to headsets with built-in radio, Bluetooth and level-dependent ambient listening. Other 3M safety products are on the 3M page.
en.bx_products_intro: Typical requests cover the following products (designations from manufacturer documentation):
en.bx_products_list:
• Passive earmuffs – Optime I (H510A, SNR 27 dB), Optime II (H520A, SNR 31 dB), Optime III (H540A, SNR 34 dB) and the X series X1–X5 with SNR 27 to 37 dB
  • Helmet-mounted earmuffs – helmet attachment versions, e.g. H510P3E, and X series with P3 or P5 adapter
  • Hearing protection headsets – ProTac III and WS ProTac XPI (level-dependent), LiteCom and LiteCom Plus with built-in two-way radio (e.g. PMR446), WS LiteCom Pro III with Bluetooth
  • Tactical headsets – ComTac, e.g. ComTac VIII, for authorities and military
  • Hygiene kits – ear cushions and foam liners, e.g. HY51 (Optime I), HY54 (Optime III), HY79 (FM Radio, ProTac, LiteCom)

en.bx_tech_title: What matters when replacing PELTOR hearing protection
en.bx_tech_list:
• Full type designation: the code (e.g. H540A, X4P3E, MT73H7P3E4410WS6EU) contains model, attachment (headband, neckband, helmet) and, for headsets, radio frequency and features.
  • Attenuation (SNR): a replacement must provide at least the required protection without over-protecting – the noise level at the workplace is decisive.
  • Helmet attachment: the helmet adapter (e.g. P3E) must match the helmet type.
  • Radio and Ex protection: frequency band (e.g. PMR446), analogue or digital, Bluetooth and ATEX approval for hazardous areas – Ex headsets need matching Ex batteries such as ACK082.
  • Hygiene kits matching the model: cushions and liners are model-specific and should be replaced regularly as per the user instructions to maintain attenuation.

en.brand_h1: ABICOR BINZEL – welding torches and wear parts
en.brand_intro: ABCspareparts sources ABICOR BINZEL welding and cutting torches and wear parts – contact tips, gas nozzles, tip holders and cable assemblies – for production and maintenance across Europe. Send us the part number and quantity – we usually reply within 24 hours.
en.brand_intro_p2: We check availability of the original part and, where technically appropriate, compatible alternatives or successor models. This page is not a live stock list: please use the non-binding request.
en.bx_about_text:
Alexander Binzel Schweisstechnik GmbH & Co. KG was founded in 1945 and is based in Buseck (Hesse, Germany). ABICOR BINZEL is the umbrella brand of the group.

The company specialised early on in gas-shielded welding and cutting torches for MIG/MAG, TIG and plasma. Torches for automated robotic welding followed later. Well known are the MB EVO and MB EVO PRO MIG/MAG manual torches and their wear parts.
en.bx_products_title: ABICOR BINZEL product groups we source
en.bx_products_intro: Typical requests cover the following products (designations from manufacturer documentation):
en.bx_products_list:
• MIG/MAG manual welding torches – e.g. MB EVO and MB EVO PRO, gas and liquid cooled
  • TIG welding torches and accessories
  • Plasma cutting torches
  • Robotic welding torches for automated welding
  • Wear parts – M6/M8 contact tips (E-Cu, CuCrZr), gas nozzles, tip holders, gas diffusers
  • Cable assemblies, torch necks and central connectors
en.bx_tech_title: What matters with ABICOR BINZEL spare parts
en.bx_tech_list:
• Torch type and size: wear parts only fit the specific torch, e.g. MB EVO PRO 24 or 501.
  • Wire diameter and material: contact tips come for different wire diameters and in E-Cu or CuCrZr, also specifically for aluminium.
  • Part number: Binzel numbers like 140.0059 identify a part clearly – note the pack size (often 10 pieces).
  • Connection: for cable assemblies state central connector, length and cooling type.
en.bx_apps_list:
• Steel and metal construction
  • Automotive and rail vehicle building
  • Robotic welding cells
  • Shipbuilding
  • Tank and plant construction
  • Maintenance and workshops
en.bx_request_title: This information speeds up your quote
en.bx_request_list:
• Full type or part number from the rating plate (a photo helps)
  • Key technical data such as voltage, size or rating
  • Plant or machine the part is installed in
  • Quantity and required delivery date
  • Original only, or compatible alternative acceptable
en.brand_faq_q4: Does ABCspareparts also source older or no longer listed ABICOR BINZEL parts?
en.brand_faq_a4: Yes. We check with the manufacturer as well as distributors and brokers in Europe. If the original is no longer available, we propose – after consultation – a successor model or compatible alternative.
en.brand_faq_q5: Which torches does ABICOR BINZEL make?
en.brand_faq_a5: Gas-shielded welding and cutting torches for MIG/MAG, TIG and plasma, torches for robotic welding and the matching accessories and wear parts.
en.brand_faq_q6: What details do you need for contact tips and gas nozzles?
en.brand_faq_a6: Torch type, wire diameter, thread (M6 or M8), material (E-Cu or CuCrZr) and ideally the Binzel part number, e.g. 140.0059.

es.gogatec_about_text: Información basada en fuentes públicas. GOGATEC GmbH, Viena, Austria. Mayorista de electrotecnia y automática en construcción de máquinas, instalaciones y cuadros con más de 40.000 artículos, marcas propias (GOGABOX, GOGACON, GOGAFIX, GOGAMARK, GOGASHRINK) y productos de marca (conectores rectangulares ILME, prensaestopas EMC Anamet). Distribuidor de Zoller + Fröhlich, Siemens, Lütze y Rittal. Certificado ISO 9001 (desde 2012) e ISO 14001 (desde 2018).
